nom: medicube Azelaic Acid Niacinamide Clarifying Toner

avis.texte: Love this product! Twice daily every day! Yes it feels slightly sticky but once you yous tour lotion on top of it, the sensation is gone!

Not a fan of this toner at all. It left my face super sticky and did not feel clean. It did not dry down and I had to wash it off to apply my foundation. I dumped out the bottle. Complete waste of money IMO.

This really helps to hydrate the skin and calm down irritation and breakouts. I use it on my back and chest where I get some mild acne, and so far I am loving it. I use it after washing with the panoxyl 2% salicylic acid cleansing bar. I recommend trying this combo!
